recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Two Modalities Under One Roof", "body": "Chance Garton opens by framing the show as mixed mental arts and introduces Michaela Crandell of AuthenticPathHealing.com, a practitioner who pairs internal family systems therapy with biofield tuning. He leans on the Carl Jung line posted on her site, that until you make the unconscious conscious it will direct your life and you will call it fate. Michaela explains she arrived as a client roughly six years ago, describing a body, mind and spirit that were a mess, and found her way to IFS through synchronicity and to Eileen and biofield tuning through YouTube videos."}, {"title": "Why the Physical Fix Was Not Enough", "body": "Michaela describes starting with natural healing and diet because she was averse to mental and emotional work, then discovering that changing her body alone did not touch her emotional health. Checking the physical items off her list left the psyche and the energy field standing out as the real priorities. She names her own yo-yo weight cycle as an emotional and spiritual issue showing up physically. Chance adds the idea of excess weight as armoring, with a tear shed for every pound lost, and Michaela agrees that removing the armor exposes the beliefs underneath."}, {"title": "How Richard Schwartz Found Parts", "body": "Michaela traces internal family systems to Dick Schwartz, who was doing clinical research with teenagers who had eating disorders inside a family constellations framework that tried to heal an individual by changing the external family. He kept hearing patients say one part of me wants to eat and another part makes me purge, briefly wondered whether they were schizophrenic, then recognized the same conflicting voices in himself. The model that grew from that says we are all naturally multifaceted, that there are no bad parts, only misguided ones, and that compassion and curiosity, not control, produce change."}, {"title": "Protectors, Exiles and Self Energy", "body": "Michaela lays out the working anatomy of a session. Exiled parts sit deep in the unconscious and get pushed back down by protectors the moment they surface, so building trust with the protector is usually the slowest part of the work. Contact happens with eyes closed in a light hypnotic state, through body sensation, inner words or plain sensing. Above the parts sits self energy, which she calls soul energy, never damaged by trauma and only ever covered up. Chance connects it to holding presence rather than feeding clients your own light and burning yourself out."}, {"title": "A Real Session, Live on the Show", "body": "Chance volunteers his suppressed grief and Michaela guides him through an unscripted demonstration. He sees a black sphere pulsing behind his rib cage, meets it with curiosity, and learns it is a protector with instructions to limit crying and swap nervous laughter for insecurity, a job it took on when he was four or five. Told his real age, it melts, revealing teeth, a belly and a call for help that leads him to a small boy alone on a snowy cliff whom he carries to a lake to go fishing. His constriction eases immediately."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Michaela Crandell is an Internal Family Systems therapist and Biofield Tuner. In this episode, we explore both modalities and how they intersect, including discussion on how the parts of our psyche can fragment, the categories of these pieces, and how to contact them to find resolution and wholeness. Michaela also guides me through a mini-session as a demonstration of how IFS works.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension, we talk more about tuning, how stuck parts of self exist in our energy fields, the importance of understanding how your birth story might condition you, ancestors in IFS and the aura, non-self entities (guides and negative beings), Michaela's toolkit and process, and much more.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Tuning the Field Through the Body", "body": "Michaela describes biofield tuning in her own words as using sound to calm the chaos of the energy field, imprinting a coherent vibration onto something dissonant. She registers perturbations somatically, feeling the sadness, anger or confusion held there, and brings heart-centered self-energy to each spot as a second layer of coherence. Chance shares his own cue, a gentle popping pressure in his ears when he hits stuck energy, which he now uses as a yes or no signal, and Michaela likens it to muscle testing. Both agree the field speaks to every practitioner differently and there is no wrong way to receive it."}, {"title": "The Birth Story as the Baseline", "body": "In the extension, Michaela frames the birth story as the foundation of how we receive the world: a hard arrival can seed the belief that life is painful and that we must protect ourselves, while support in processing birth can leave a person feeling safe. Chance finds more and more of his sessions ending up at the birth edge of the field, likening it to pulling something up by the roots so later layers need less attention. Michaela notes that many people do not know their birth story, which is where tuning helps, because the gestation and birth area can be found without knowing any of the facts."}, {"title": "Guides, Entities and Lost Souls", "body": "Michaela explains that IFS assumes something is a part until questioning shows otherwise. If it is not a part and carries positive intention, it is a guide, often an ancestor, that drops in information and leaves. Something with only negative intentions gets placed in a bubble and sent off, and she has never had a client report one coming back, calling them all bark and no bite. Chance raises the old Greek sense of demonia as the spirits of deceased humans, and Michaela agrees that some souls get confused and lost and attach to the living. Chance holds that free will is the highest truth in the universe."}, {"title": "Making the Practice Your Own", "body": "Asked about her toolkit, Michaela says her extras are mostly lenses rather than objects: esoteric study such as The Kybalion, archetype cards and tarot. She lets a pendulum and the field choose where to work, uses a massage bed as a stand-in for the client, sometimes places a Lemurian crystal, and clears her dedicated space with sage, palo santo and the forks themselves. Chance pulls oracle and tarot cards alongside a color-coded Prism Deck, maps the chakras with dowsing rods, and prepares with qigong. Both stress that minimalist and elaborate setups are equally valid, and that feeling like you are making it up is part of the flow."}, {"title": "Symbolism, Conspiracy and Free Will", "body": "On the trend of young people self-identifying with dissociative identity disorder, Michaela holds two views at once, a part of her wary and another part compassionate, since a label can be the only healing someone can manage at that stage. She describes waking up to corruption at every level and sees people as programmable biological computers, while Chance counters that machines resemble us rather than the reverse. Chance argues authentic conspiracy research and spiritual development are two sides of one coin, and that symbolism lets truth slip through any media. Michaela closes on love and centered energy as the most powerful force, and Chance on reading life like a dream."}]
